meta.name: role-pools
meta.purpose: Roles resolve to an ORDERED POOL of models across substrates, not a single pin. The dispatcher tries the pool top-down and fails over to the next candidate on 429 / rate-limit / unavailability. This removes the single-provider dependency that let an Anthropic rate limit block ALL spawns.
meta.principle: A role is an abstraction; many models can fulfill it. Ordering is preference (capability + quota-headroom); every pool is non-Anthropic-first so no spawn depends on the Anthropic 5h window.
meta.authority: Advisory routing pool. Governance + arm flags always win. Native Anthropic (opus/sonnet/haiku) is deliberately NOT in the lane pools — it is reached via OMP task(), not lane-dispatch; add it only as an explicit owner-chosen last resort.
meta.dispatchPrimitive: _SYSTEM/Scripts/lane-dispatch.mjs <lane> "<prompt>" [--model <id>] --out <file> — the shared retry+429-detecting wrapper over llm-lane.mjs that glm-fleet and ollama-fleet already ride.
